name: SBEC Systems (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, SBEC Systems (India) Ltd is in the business of supplying equipment and consultancy services to the industries
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is an engineering and consultancy company which renders scientific, technical, engineering, professional, commercial and
other types of skilled services and deals 
in designs, plans and specifications of contracts turnkey or otherwise, assignments, processes and undertakes fabrication, erection, commissioning of projects and providing high-tech equipment to sugar and power industries

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.94 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 167 days.
